usedFor: Stripe creates the customers, and Google Sheets holds your tracking rows. When “New Customer Created” fires in Stripe, “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets can fill in columns on a row.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in Stripe, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Stripe pushes each new customer as it happens, and the action writes its columns into a row. Of the two actions, it changes a single row rather than several.

watchOut: None of this pair's actions adds a new row. “Update Spreadsheet Row” and “Update Multiple Rows” change rows already in the sheet, so each customer needs a row before the trigger fires.
